name: Microsoft Common Objects in COntext (MS COCO)
description: The Microsoft Common Objects in COntext (MS COCO) dataset is designed to advance object recognition by providing images of complex everyday scenes with common objects in their natural context. It contains 328,000 images with 91 object categories and 2.5 million labeled instances, focusing on instance-level segmentation.
citeAs: Tsung-Yi Lin, Michael Maire, Serge Belongie, Lubomir Bourdev, Ross Girshick, James Hays, Pietro Perona, Deva Ramanan, C. Lawrence Zitnick, Piotr Dollár. Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context. arXiv:1405.0312v3 [cs.CV] 21 Feb 2015

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from Flickr using object-object and object-scene queries to gather non-iconic images. Extensive use of Amazon Mechanical Turk was employed for annotation.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for advancing object recognition, scene understanding, and precise 2D localization of objects.
